image_description: A close-up studio shot of an ornate, vintage-style statement necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a bib design with multiple irregular, leaf-shaped or petal-shaped pendants hanging from a central chain. These pendants appear to be made of textured metal (possibly brass or bronze) with inlaid colorful stones (green, amber, purple) and intricate filigree or granulation details. The upper portion consists of a chain with small beads and larger faceted gemstones.

To analyze the reflectivity of the metal and the clarity of the gemstones for signs of AI-generated blur or melting.
